# pve_sdn_route_map_entry (Resource)

One entry (order, match, set, action) of an FRR route map.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_sdn_route_map_entry" "example" {
  action       = "permit"
  order        = 1
  route_map_id = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Matching policy of a route map entry. One of: `permit`, `deny`.
- `order` (Number) The index of this route map entry
- `route_map_id` (String) The SDN route map identifier

### Optional

- `call` (String) The SDN route map identifier
- `delete` (List of String) <array>
- `exit_action` (String) key=<on-match-goto|on-match-next|continue> [,value=<integer>]
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `match` (List of String) <array>
- `set` (List of String) <array>

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: route_map_id/order (also the `terraform import` format).
